title: A counterexample to the nearby Lagrangian conjecture

result.label: A counterexample to the nearby Lagrangian conjecture
result.statement: Disproves the unrestricted nearby Lagrangian conjecture. For some sufficiently large even N , constructs a closed exact embedded Lagrangian in T^(S^9 S^ N-1 ) that is diffeomorphic to the base but not Hamiltonian isotopic to its zero section.
